messages:
maria-galvez: Quick thread - rethinking how much fidelity we keep in control-plane -> runtime service-binding for hosted/dedicated/private. More fidelity = safer rollbacks but tighter coupling. tradeoffs?

ajay-patel: +1. Suggest we split fields into 'safety-critical' vs 'advisory' so downgrades are well-scoped.

sam-wu: My quick list: routing policy, credential surface, KV cache hints, batching hints. routing+creds = safety-critical; cache/batching = advisory.

elaine: Reminder: private mode already forces some topology/network hints to be visible to control-plane. Means a single opaque manifest won't be enough.

nick-h: Thinking in terms of three tiers: full, compat, minimal. Full = everything. Compat = subset preserving routing & security. Minimal = model_id + region. Runtime should signal which tier it accepted.

maria-galvez: Proposal: compat-tier fields = model_id, model_variant, max_tokens, routing_tag, fallback_chain, auth_claims. minimal = model_id, region_tag. Objections?

ajay-patel: Fine but auth_claims are sticky. We must NOT silently downgrade auth behavior; any reduction requires explicit operator approval + audit log.

sam-wu: Add a circuit header so runtime can tell control-plane `effective-tier=compat;reason=capacity` to aid debugging/alerts.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: runtime-proxy/canary v2 will include compat-tier header and metrics. (triggered by @maria-galvez)

elaine: Schema versioning note: semver the manifest and include lightweight migration adapters. Control plane should keep translation adapters (compat -> full) rather than forcing runtime to implement many permutations.

maria-galvez: Action items: 1) @ajay-patel + @sam-wu: compat-tier matrix (fields -> tier, downgrade safety rationale). 2) @elaine: draft header spec + metrics mapping. 3) @nick-h: doc snippet for user-visible fallback behavior & SLO expectations. I'll create an RFC patch tomorrow summarizing decisions.

sam-wu: Telemetry must include `effective_tier` label and `accepted_tier_reason` tag so we can correlate quality regressions to tier changes.

maria-galvez: Also add a short-run playbook for incidents when we detect unexpected compat downgrade (auto-notify oncall + owner).

nick-h: I'll add a curl example + sample response header: `X-Runtime-Tier: compat; reason=capacity`.

maria-galvez: OK wrapping up. No major objections apart from the auth-downgrade explicitness caveat. Thanks everyone :tada:
